correctness.rationale: For any positive initial aggregate strain prevalences, conservation gives z−sigma21 R2>=J1 and z−sigma12 R1>=J2. Thus exact J_i derivative equations imply O(t^-1) bound. Damped convolution proves z−(beta1 J1+beta2 J2)/mu=O(t^-2), secondary infections O(t^-2), recovered R_i−gamma_i J_i/mu=O(t^-2). The logarithmic-time competition system has integrable perturbations; the ratio differential equation plus logistic comparison proves u1->0 and u2->1/a2. Reciprocal-ratio integration proves log(t)*t J1->1/k. Stable linear integration proves log(t)*(tJ2−1/a2)->−b21/(a2*k). The full normalized ODE, coefficients, denominator positivity, all nonzero initial quantities, and constants were checked against the accessible primary model, and two independent whole-system numerical integrations passed finite checks. Finite simulations are not infinite-time proof.

originality.rationale: The verified arXiv 2024 and peer-reviewed 2026 versions analyze local coexistence equilibria (R_i>1), not the double-critical disease-free regime R_i=1 together with marginal competition and exact inverse-logarithmic exclusion. Existing same-model work focuses on interior-equilibrium stability; its full text was not accessible here, retained as risk. Multiple published-finding corpus and external claim/equivalence/broader searches plus own historical claim checks found no covering statement. A nonindexed or general theorem could subsume the result and search absence alone is not evidence of originality.
residual_risks: Chung and Lui 2016 complete primary full text was not acquired; accessible materials address local endemic stability, not a definitive exclusion of a critical asymptotic.
Kadyrov et al. 2025 full paper was not materially readable beyond abstract/metadata; its model is not identical but exact broader coverage cannot be ruled out.
General nonlinear asymptotic theory or unindexed literature may imply this specific result; no uniqueness or independent novelty certification is asserted.

value.rationale: This identifies a mathematically motivated, otherwise unresolved nonhyperbolic regime of a canonical two-strain epidemic with the exact 1/(t log t) versus 1/t extinction hierarchy, universal parameter-dependent coefficients and next correction. The marginal-competition condition is an interpretable sharp balance of interstrain and self-limitation effects. The result extends explicit biological model understanding, not an arbitrary number computation or mere numerical recheck.
